title: Romantic Getaway to Nova Scotia: A Couple's Guide for 2026
metaDescription: Plan the perfect romantic trip to Nova Scotia. Sunset spots, intimate dining, and unforgettable experiences for couples in love.
excerpt: Nova Scotia sets the stage for romance like nowhere else. From sunset views to intimate dinners, this guide will help you plan the perfect couple's getaway.
author: Travel Editors
content:
There is something about Nova Scotia that captures the imagination of travelers worldwide. For those planning a romantic getaway to Nova Scotia, this guide will show you the best of what awaits.

## Most Romantic Spots

- Sunset viewpoints that offer breathtaking panoramas over Nova Scotia
- Secluded beaches and hidden coves perfect for private moments
- Candlelit restaurants serving the finest local cuisine
- Scenic walks through charming neighborhoods and historic streets

![Romantic Nova Scotia](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1526940946820-a61d0f92194e?fm=webp&w=1200&q=60)

## Romantic Activities

Hot air balloon rides over Nova Scotia provide a magical perspective that you will never forget.

## Where to Stay

Luxury resorts with private pools and ocean views create the ultimate romantic atmosphere in Nova Scotia.
